title: ES 4 RXV · Gross OHLC payoff proxy
summary: Earlier trend → one opposite candle → resumption. Compare saved results by earlier trend length, direction, year and all seven session windows; exact counts are downloadable.

sections.title: Read the A → B → R setup
sections.body: A is a consecutive original-direction leg, B is exactly one completed opposite-colour candle, and R is the next completed candle returning to A's direction. All three are adjacent within the same eligible session. Bullish example: bullish A1,A2,A3 → bearish B → bullish R → bullish F1 → bullish F2. This has earlier A length 3 and succeeds at n=2; R and B are excluded from n. Bearish events mirror that sequence. The earlier trend filter measures A, not the one-candle B pullback. A must have an observed completed end at B. Exact known starts use the whole A length; unknown A starts have their own group. An A length of one can be simple alternating candles and is not treated as a substantial trend. Choose year, session and earlier trend length in the tables. All years + All hours gives overall; a year + All hours gives yearly; All years + a named window gives session; a year + a window gives year-by-session. The All earlier legs row overlaps the disjoint size rows; do not sum it with them. The payoff view is a gross OHLC price-path proxy. Reference entry is F1.open after R; bullish stop = min(B.low,R.low) − 0.25, bearish stop = max(B.high,R.high) + 0.25. Risk is the positive entry-to-stop distance. Separate targets are 1R and 2R. Follow ten physical completed candles starting at F1, including opposite/doji candles. Each opening is checked before its extrema: an opening beyond a boundary exits at that observed open. A sole stop touch gives −1R; a sole target touch gives the target R. Both touched within one candle have unresolved order and contribute payoff bounds [−1R,target R]. Otherwise exit at the tenth close. A session/completion barrier before resolution is unknown. Missing entry, invalid risk and unresolved outcomes are excluded from known-outcome means/rates and listed separately. Win bounds mean strictly positive proxy payoff. No fill, costs, slippage, net returns, dollars or portfolio performance are established. The nominal 0.25 buffer and exported chart prices do not verify contract or adjustment history.

sections.title: Overall sample

sections.title: Overall gross OHLC payoff bounds
sections.description: Means and positive-payoff rates use known OHLC proxy outcomes, including bounded intrabar ambiguity. Unknown includes missing entry and unresolved path; invalid risk is separate. Bounds reflect order ambiguity, not confidence intervals. Overlapping setups and the two target scenarios must not be combined as a trading portfolio.
sections.patternFocus: Compare separate 1R and 2R target scenarios from F1.open over ten physical bars. Opening crosses take precedence; same-bar dual touches retain bounds. An unresolved barrier is unknown; a complete unresolved path exits at C10.close.

sections.title: Timing, windows and interpretation
sections.body: Event groups use R's completion proxy (when the signal becomes known), rather than its opening or outcome time. Year uses its inferred 18:00-rollover session date. Follow-up continues across named-window endpoints but never across inferred daily sessions or completion barriers. NY wall-time windows: Asia 20:00–02:00; London 02:00–09:00; NY 09:30–16:00; Asia Open 19:30–21:30; NY Open 09:30–10:30; NY AM 10:30–12:30; NY PM 12:30–16:00. Start included, end excluded. Overlapping windows cannot all be summed. 2019 and 2026 have partial coverage. The entire partial final session 2026-09-24 is excluded. Bar coverage is anchored at bar opening, separately from event completion-time groups. Original same-second and identical rows retain source order. OHLC is available; volume, exact completion and contract/roll treatment are unverified. These are descriptive historical frequencies on already-inspected history, without independent forecast validation, iid confidence intervals or trading profitability evidence.

notes: Pooled-direction results and exact unrounded counts/rates for every year, window and earlier-leg cohort are included in CSVs. Displayed rates retain six decimals before formatting.
Payoff bounds are gross OHLC scenarios in entry-to-stop R units. Costs and executable fills are unmodeled; no net profitability claim.
